verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Datadog feature for exporting all account data (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards) in open formats to support leaving the platform. OpenTelemetry support covers ingestion, not export, and the general API Reference is at most a developer building block, so neither earns credit. A community comment (datadog-comm-22) also notes that APM traces lock companies in and that exporting them would make moving easier, which suggests no such export path exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
